data.one_liner: A heavily opinionated analysis_options for Dart and Flutter projects with strict lint rules.
data.what_it_does: Provides a pre-configured analysis_options.yaml file containing strict and justified lint rules for Dart and Flutter projects. It tracks Dart SDK updates and includes documented justifications for rule preferences.
use_when: You want a stricter set of lint rules than standard packages provide
You prefer having documented justifications for linter overrides
avoid_when: Your project requires lenient linting rules or specific rule exclusions not provided
You prefer writing your own custom analysis_options from scratch
strengths: Regularly updated to match Dart SDK changes and new linter rules
Includes comments and explanations for chosen lint rules
weaknesses: Heavily opinionated rules may cause friction on certain team workflows or legacy codebases
data.setup_notes: Add to dev_dependencies in pubspec.yaml and include package:strict/analysis_options.yaml in analysis_options.yaml.

alternatives.name: flutter_lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Flutter team lint rules which are typically much less strict and more universally accepted.

alternatives.name: lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Dart team lint rules providing a standard baseline for packages and apps.

dev_dependencies:
